test.create_query: CREATE TABLE jit_decimal (d32 Decimal32(2), d64 Decimal64(4), i8 Int8, i32 Int32) Engine = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO jit_decimal SELECT toDecimal32((cityHash64(number) % 2000000) / 100 - 10000, 2), toDecimal64((cityHash64(number, 1) % 2000000000) / 10000 - 100000, 4), toInt8(cityHash64(number, 2)), toInt32(cityHash64(number, 3)) FROM numbers(50000000)
test.query: SELECT sum(identity(d64 + d32)) FROM jit_decimal SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
SELECT sum(identity(d32 * toDecimal32(1.5, 1))) FROM jit_decimal SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
SELECT sum(identity(d64 / (d32 + toDecimal32(20000, 2)))) FROM jit_decimal SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
SELECT countIf(d64 > toDecimal64(0, 4) AND d32 < toDecimal32(100, 2)) FROM jit_decimal SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
SELECT sum(throwIf(i8 > 200) + i32) FROM jit_decimal SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
